**Standard Job Description**
Join our team as a Senior AI Engineer focused on ontologies, knowledge graphs, and production AI systems.
  
  
You will turn complex enterprise data into trusted knowledge that AI applications can understand and use. You will work directly with users, domain experts, data owners, and platform teams.
  
  
This role uses a forward-deployed engineering model. You will identify user problems, build solutions, deploy them, and improve them through direct feedback.
  
  
You will own work from early discovery through production support. You must be comfortable with unclear requirements, unfamiliar data, and complex system constraints.
  
  
**Responsibilities Include**

* Work with users and domain experts to define problems, outcomes, and technical requirements.
* Convert enterprise concepts and source metadata into clear ontologies and semantic models.
* Design knowledge graphs that connect business meaning to source data.
* Build AI agent workflows that create, evaluate, and improve ontology artifacts.
* Develop evaluation methods for AI quality, source traceability, query accuracy, and human review.
* Integrate relational databases, APIs, files, cloud platforms, and enterprise data systems.
* Build production software across services, APIs, background jobs, web applications, and graph query systems.
* Create tests and controls for AI output, ontology quality, data mappings, and production behavior.
* Deploy software through automated pipelines, containers, and cloud platforms.
* Observe production systems and resolve failures across application, AI, data, and infrastructure components.
* Make clear tradeoffs among user value, technical quality, security, schedule, and long-term support.
* Present technical decisions to engineering teams, domain experts, and business leaders.
* Review designs and code, mentor other engineers, and improve team engineering practices.
* Apply lessons from each user engagement to reusable platform capabilities.

This position is for a senior individual contributor. The engineer will lead technical work without requiring formal personnel authority.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* A bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, Applied Mathematics, or a related STEM field, with five years of relevant experience.
* A master’s degree with three years of relevant experience can satisfy the education and experience requirement.
* Experience developing production software in Python, including services, APIs, data pipelines, or distributed applications.
* Experience building and deploying AI, machine learning, LLM, or agent-based systems beyond an initial prototype.
* Experience designing ontologies or knowledge graphs with RDF, OWL, and SPARQL.
* Experience working directly with users or domain experts to convert unclear needs into deployed software.

**Desired Skills**

* Experience with SHACL, R2RML, ontology reasoning, ontology governance, or competency-question evaluation.
* Experience with graph databases or virtual knowledge graph platforms, such as Amazon Neptune or Ontop.
* Experience with AI agent frameworks and model platforms, such as Strands Agents, AWS Bedrock, or Azure OpenAI.
* Experience evaluating LLM systems for accuracy, traceability, safety, reliability, cost, and latency.
* Experience with Django, REST APIs, asynchronous Python, Celery, PostgreSQL, or Redis.
* Experience with React, TypeScript, or full-stack application development.
* Experience connecting SQL databases, REST APIs, OpenAPI specifications, files, or Databricks.
* Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, OpenShift, Helm, and CI/CD pipelines.
* Experience with production observability, structured logs, metrics, tracing, and incident resolution.
* Experience applying security and access controls to enterprise AI or data systems.
* Experience with ontology editors, semantic modeling tools, or graph visualization tools.
* Experience mentoring engineers or leading technical work across multiple teams.
* Experience delivering software in a customer environment with changing requirements and limited information.

Join our team as a Senior AI Engineer focused on ontologies, knowledge graphs, and production AI systems.
  
  
You will turn complex enterprise data into trusted knowledge that AI applications can understand and use. You will work directly with users, domain experts, data owners, and platform teams.
  
  
This role uses a forward-deployed engineering model. You will identify user problems, build solutions, deploy them, and improve them through direct feedback.
  
  
You will own work from early discovery through production support. You must be comfortable with unclear requirements, unfamiliar data, and complex system constraints.

* Design knowledge graphs that connect business meaning to source data.
* Build AI agent workflows that create, evaluate, and improve ontology artifacts.
* Develop evaluation methods for AI quality, source traceability, query accuracy, and human review.
* Integrate relational databases, APIs, files, cloud platforms, and enterprise data systems.
* Build production software across services, APIs, background jobs, web applications, and graph query systems.
* Create tests and controls for AI output, ontology quality, data mappings, and production behavior.
* Deploy software through automated pipelines, containers, and cloud platforms.
* Observe production systems and resolve failures across application, AI, data, and infrastructure components.
* Make clear tradeoffs among user value, technical quality, security, schedule, and long-term support.
* Present technical decisions to engineering teams, domain experts, and business leaders.
* Review designs and code, mentor other engineers, and improve team engineering practices.
* Apply lessons from each user engagement to reusable platform capabilities.

This position is for a senior individual contributor. The engineer will lead technical work without requiring formal personnel authority.

* A bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, Applied Mathematics, or a related STEM field, with five years of relevant experience.

* Experience building and deploying AI, machine learning, LLM, or agent-based systems beyond an initial prototype.

* Experience mentoring engineers or leading technical work across multiple teams.
* Experience delivering software in a customer environment with changing requirements and limited information.

**Standard Job Description**
Join our team as a Staff AI Engineer focused on ontologies, knowledge graphs, and production AI systems. You will define how complex enterprise data becomes trusted knowledge that AI applications can understand and use.
  
  
This role uses a forward-deployed engineering model. You will work directly with users, domain experts, data owners, and engineering teams. You will identify high-value problems and turn unclear needs into secure, reliable production capabilities. You will remain responsible from initial discovery through deployment and operation.
  
  
As a Staff individual contributor, you will set technical direction across projects and teams. You will solve complex system problems, guide senior engineers, and create reusable platform capabilities. You will lead through technical judgment, delivery results, and trusted relationships. Formal personnel authority is not required.
  
  
**Responsibilities Include**

* Lead technical discovery with users, domain experts, data owners, and engineering teams.
* Convert business needs into system requirements, architecture decisions, and delivery plans.
* Define architectures for AI agents, ontologies, knowledge graphs, data integrations, and user applications.
* Design semantic models that represent business concepts instead of physical source structures.
* Establish methods for ontology governance, source traceability, evaluation, version control, and human review.
* Build AI agent workflows that create, test, and improve trusted knowledge artifacts.
* Define evaluation methods for AI quality, semantic accuracy, query results, reliability, cost, and latency.
* Integrate databases, APIs, files, cloud platforms, and enterprise data systems.
* Lead development across services, APIs, background jobs, web applications, and graph query systems.
* Guide deployment through automated pipelines, containers, and cloud platforms.
* Resolve complex failures across AI models, applications, data sources, and infrastructure.
* Make tradeoffs among user value, security, quality, schedule, cost, and long-term support.
* Convert engagement-specific solutions into reusable platform capabilities.
* Review architecture and code for quality, security, supportability, and system fit.
* Mentor engineers and establish consistent engineering practices across teams.
* Present technical decisions, risks, and results to technical and business leaders.
* Influence technical direction across teams without formal authority.

**Basic Qualifications**

* A bachelor’s degree in a related STEM field and nine years of relevant experience.
* A master’s degree with seven years or a PhD with four years can satisfy the education and experience requirement.
* Experience developing production software in Python and architecting distributed or cloud-based systems.
* Experience architecting and deploying production AI, LLM, machine learning, or agent-based systems.
* Experience designing ontologies or knowledge graphs with RDF, OWL, and SPARQL.
* Experience leading technical work across teams and converting unclear user needs into deployed solutions.

**Desired Skills**

* Advanced experience with OWL, SHACL, R2RML, SPARQL, ontology reasoning, or semantic validation.
* Experience defining ontology governance, model reuse, version control, and review practices.
* Experience with graph databases or virtual knowledge graph systems.
* Experience with Amazon Neptune, Ontop, RDFLib, or comparable semantic platforms.
* Experience with AI agent frameworks and enterprise model platforms.
* Experience with AWS Bedrock, Azure OpenAI, or comparable model services.
* Experience evaluating LLM systems for accuracy, traceability, reliability, security, cost, and latency.
* Experience designing human review and approval controls for AI-generated artifacts.
* Experience with Django, asynchronous Python, Celery, PostgreSQL, Redis, or comparable technologies.
* Experience with React, TypeScript, or full-stack application development.
* Experience integrating SQL databases, REST APIs, OpenAPI specifications, files, or Databricks.
* Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, OpenShift, Helm, and CI/CD pipelines.
* Experience with production observability, incident response, and root-cause analysis.
* Experience applying security and access controls to enterprise AI or data systems.
* Experience leading architecture reviews or technical standards across engineering teams.
* Experience mentoring senior engineers and improving team engineering practices.
* Experience delivering software in customer environments with unclear or changing requirements.
* Experience converting customer-specific solutions into reusable products or platform services.

**Introduction**
At IBM Software, we transform client challenges into solutions. Building the world's leading AI-powered, cloud-native products that shape the future of business and society. Our legacy of innovation creates endless opportunities for IBMers to learn, grow, and make an impact on a global scale. Working in Software means joining a team fueled by curiosity and collaboration. You'll work with diverse technologies, partners, and industries to design, develop, and deliver solutions that power digital transformation. With a culture that values innovation, growth, and continuous learning, IBM Software places you at the heart of IBM's product and technology landscape. Here, you'l have the tools and opportunities to advance your career while creating software that changes the world.
  
  
**Your Role And Responsibilities**
Build AI for the systems the world relies on. At IBM Z, our technology supports the transactions and data behind banking, payments, and global commerce. We are bringing AI into that foundation to help developers build faster, simplify complex operations, and solve problems where reliability, security, and performance matter.
  
  
As an AI Software Engineer Intern, you will work alongside experienced engineers to turn advances in large language models into useful software. Depending on your team, you could build an agent that helps diagnose system issues, connect AI to enterprise data and tools, or create a simpler way for developers to work with complex systems. Bring your ideas, experiment, and help take a feature from prototype through testing and refinement.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Design, build, and test AI-powered features that address real developer and client needs, with guidance from experienced engineers.
* Integrate LLMs, APIs, and enterprise data into applications, exploring agent workflows, tool calling, and retrieval where they fit the problem.
* Write clear specifications and effective prompts, use AI development tools thoughtfully, and review and test the code they produce.
* Evaluate AI behavior with realistic test cases, measure quality and performance, and improve how applications handle incorrect outputs and failures.
* Debug across model interactions, application code, APIs, and underlying systems to understand root causes and build reliable solutions.
* Collaborate through Git, code reviews, and technical discussions; document your work and iterate on feedback.

* Make tradeoffs among user value, security, quality, schedule, cost, and long-term support.
* Convert engagement-specific solutions into reusable platform capabilities.
* Review architecture and code for quality, security, supportability, and system fit.
* Mentor engineers and establish consistent engineering practices across teams.
* Present technical decisions, risks, and results to technical and business leaders.
* Influence technical direction across teams without formal authority.

**Basic Qualifications**

* A bachelor’s degree in a related STEM field and nine years of relevant experience.
* A master’s degree with seven years or a PhD with four years can satisfy the education and experience requirement.
* Experience developing production software in Python and architecting distributed or cloud-based systems.
* Experience architecting and deploying production AI, LLM, machine learning, or agent-based systems.
* Experience designing ontologies or knowledge graphs with RDF, OWL, and SPARQL.
* Experience leading technical work across teams and converting unclear user needs into deployed solutions.

**Desired Skills**

* Advanced experience with OWL, SHACL, R2RML, SPARQL, ontology reasoning, or semantic validation.
* Experience defining ontology governance, model reuse, version control, and review practices.
* Experience with graph databases or virtual knowledge graph systems.
* Experience with Amazon Neptune, Ontop, RDFLib, or comparable semantic platforms.
* Experience with AI agent frameworks and enterprise model platforms.
* Experience with AWS Bedrock, Azure OpenAI, or comparable model services.
* Experience evaluating LLM systems for accuracy, traceability, reliability, security, cost, and latency.
* Experience designing human review and approval controls for AI-generated artifacts.
* Experience with Django, asynchronous Python, Celery, PostgreSQL, Redis, or comparable technologies.
* Experience with React, TypeScript, or full-stack application development.
* Experience integrating SQL databases, REST APIs, OpenAPI specifications, files, or Databricks.
* Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, OpenShift, Helm, and CI/CD pipelines.
* Experience with production observability, incident response, and root-cause analysis.
* Experience applying security and access controls to enterprise AI or data systems.
* Experience leading architecture reviews or technical standards across engineering teams.
* Experience mentoring senior engineers and improving team engineering practices.
* Experience delivering software in customer environments with unclear or changing requirements.
* Experience converting customer-specific solutions into reusable products or platform services.

**WHAT WE'RE DOING**
Lockheed Martin Rotary and Mission Systems is looking for Software professionals to work on Cross-Domain Solution (CDS) products that protect and defend the information flow of critical and time sensitive data on many military application and networks.
  
  
**Who We Are**
At Lockheed Martin Rotary and Mission Systems (RMS), you will ensure cyber security standards are met and implemented.
  
  
**Who You Are**
The candidate will be working in an agile development environment on RedHat Linux-based OS, and will be responsible for supporting elements of the design/sustainment/development efforts. The candidate should be a well-rounded software developer with experience in an object oriented language, such as C++, C# and Java. The candidate should be a self-starter that is attentive to details and works well in a team.
  
  
**THE WORK**
Duties to include software design and development in a Java/C++/C# SELinux environment, SELinux Policy creation, maintenance and debugging, message parser development, XML schema development, network protocol integration, shell scripting development, and software test.
  
  
Additionally, the proven ability to provide software engineering is required. Flexibility and agility to changing requirements and programming languages, and a desire to learn and experience new opportunities to improve team performance is a must.
  
  
Applicants selected will be subject to a government security investigation and must meet eligibility requirements for access to classified information.
  
  
Join the team to help become “Raise the Bar” compliant. This compliance will involve the implementation of new stream and file pipelines for many different protocols including video.
  
  
This team promotes the Agile Methodologies, where it has 4 3-month increments per year. Each increment has 4 3-week sprints. A typical sprint will include planning, retrospectives, demos to stakeholders, development and test stories, and finally selloffs to track progress to a product owner. Each team will consist of a Scrum Master and 4-7 developers and testers. The development teams works within the Deer Creek facility and at times can work remote.
  
  
In addition as a developer for TMAN if you will have opportunities to volunteer support to the end customers by travelling to site and performing installations or trainings of the cross domain solution.
  
  
The individual selected for this team will need to have a high level of self and team motivation. An ideal candidate will be a self-starter and a strong problem solver. They will also need to have a deep understanding of continuous integration and deployment (CI/CD).
  
  
Many digital transformation techniques are used to facilitate development on the problem include Jenkins, Atlassian Suite of Tools, automated testing through software integration tests (SWIT), CPPUnit, JUnits with JMockit, and Eggplant.
  
  
This position will involve software development using Java / C++/C# and some bsh/python 80% of the time with a team that collaborates between each other hourly. SELInux policies are also important to TMAN as we are required to run our software with SELinux enabled. The Cross domain solution also requires strong linux and networking knowledge.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* DoD Interim Secret Security Clearance
* Working knowledge of C++, C# or Java
* Some knowledge of network programming, TCP, UDP, IPC
* Object-Oriented development
* Unit Testing – GTest, Junit, Jmockit

**Desired Skills**

* Python, Perl, Bash
* Linux
* SELinux
* Security+
* Cross Domain Solutions
* Raise the Bar
* CI/CD - Jenkins, Fortify, Sonarqube
* Version Control: Git/Bitbucket

**Standard Job Description**
**WHAT WE'RE DOING**
Lockheed Martin Rotary and Mission Systems is looking for Software professionals to work on Cross-Domain Solution (CDS) products that protect and defend the information flow of critical and time sensitive data on many military application and networks.
  
  
**Who We Are**
At Lockheed Martin Rotary and Mission Systems (RMS), you will ensure cyber security standards are met and implemented.
  
  
**Who You Are**
The candidate will be working in an agile development environment on RedHat Linux-based OS, and will be responsible for supporting elements of the design/sustainment/development efforts. The candidate should be a well-rounded software developer with experience in an object oriented language, such as C++, C# and Java. The candidate should be a self-starter that is attentive to details and works well in a team.
  
  
**THE WORK**
Duties to include software design and development in a Java/C++/C# SELinux environment, SELinux Policy creation, maintenance and debugging, message parser development, XML schema development, network protocol integration, shell scripting development, and software test.
  
  
Additionally, the proven ability to provide software engineering is required. Flexibility and agility to changing requirements and programming languages, and a desire to learn and experience new opportunities to improve team performance is a must.
  
  
Applicants selected will be subject to a government security investigation and must meet eligibility requirements for access to classified information.
  
  
Join the team to help become “Raise the Bar” compliant. This compliance will involve the implementation of new stream and file pipelines for many different protocols including video.
  
  
This team promotes the Agile Methodologies, where it has 4 3-month increments per year. Each increment has 4 3-week sprints. A typical sprint will include planning, retrospectives, demos to stakeholders, development and test stories, and finally selloffs to track progress to a product owner. Each team will consist of a Scrum Master and 4-7 developers and testers. The development teams works within the Deer Creek facility and at times can work remote.
  
  
In addition as a developer for TMAN if you will have opportunities to volunteer support to the end customers by travelling to site and performing installations or trainings of the cross domain solution.
  
  
The individual selected for this team will need to have a high level of self and team motivation. An ideal candidate will be a self-starter and a strong problem solver. They will also need to have a deep understanding of continuous integration and deployment (CI/CD).
  
  
Many digital transformation techniques are used to facilitate development on the problem include Jenkins, Atlassian Suite of Tools, automated testing through software integration tests (SWIT), CPPUnit, JUnits with JMockit, and Eggplant.
  
  
This position will involve software development using Java / C++/C# and some bsh/python 80% of the time with a team that collaborates between each other hourly. SELInux policies are also important to TMAN as we are required to run our software with SELinux enabled. The Cross domain solution also requires strong linux and networking knowledge.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* DoD Interim Secret Security Clearance
* Working knowledge of C++, C# or Java
* Some knowledge of network programming, TCP, UDP, IPC
* Object-Oriented development
* Unit Testing – GTest, Junit, Jmockit

**Desired Skills**

* Python, Perl, Bash
* Linux
* SELinux
* Security+
* Cross Domain Solutions
* Raise the Bar
* CI/CD - Jenkins, Fortify, Sonarqube
* Version Control: Git/Bitbucket

**Standard Job Description**
The 1LMX ERP Production Operations IT Team is specifically transforming Lockheed Martin businesses using the latest SAP S/4HANA ERP systems to drive to a common set of streamlined processes and deliver results for our customers. Within this initiative, we are hiring an experienced SAP Developer to support our various scrum teams: Product Data Management Integration (PDMI), Transportation Management (TM), Logistics Execution (LE), Warehouse Management (WM), Inventory Management (IM), Production Planning (PP), Material Management (MM), Material Requirements Planning (MRP), Global Trade Services (GTS), etc.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
You will support the Plan-to-Stock Value Stream. Your responsibilities are based on a broad knowledge of IT and include, but are not limited to the following:
  
  

* Owning HOW data is being sent/received
* Supporting proof of concepts, ensuring proposed code changes are both feasible and sustainable while minimizing technical debt in all designs
* Supporting and subsequently executing software development scoping, sizing activities for identified RICEWF requirements
* Reviewing functional and technical specifications for quality, programmability and ensuring a scalable approach
* Working with middleware on how to optimally make multiple systems interface with one another using the best technical approach
* Collaborating with other Plan-To-Stock (PTS) IT developers with complex design decisions, product evaluations, or other technical obstacles
* Collaborating with partner technology teams to accomplish goals

This role requires approximately 25% travel for on-site events.
  
  
**The Project Will Consist Of The Following Phases**

* Planning
* Functional Specs
* Development Unit Test
* Functional Unit Test
* ITC
* UAT
* Training
* Cutover
* Go-Live

**Basic Qualifications**
Seeking a Software Architect that is a very approachable team player that collaborates well with others
  
  
Strong technical and problem solving skills in assisting development team with technical challenges across numerous complex products including but not limited to: ESH/PCCM, SFI, MRP, Tooling, GTS, WM/IM, eWM, PPDS, CSO, TM, MS/DM, PLMSI
  
  
Must have functional knowledge
  
  
Tech Spec and code review
  
  
DDIC Governance, Package creation, OSS Notes
  
  

* Proven SAP design and development experience in SAP ECC or SAP S/4HANA systems
* Experience with large scale implementations
* Experience with ABAP Development
* Experience with SAP design and development
* Strong communication skills and ability to lead collaborative work

**Desired Skills**
Capability to handle many requests coming from ProdOps as well as other potential ARTs that impact us (ex. CTI)
  
  

* First-hand Experience with classic SAP tools/skills such as Restful ABAP (RAP), ABAP Development Tools (ADT), ALV, Adobe Forms, ALE/IDOC, RFC/BAPI,BADI/enhancements, Workflow, LSMW/LTMC, CDS Views (Table Functions, Virtual Elements), AMDP, AIF, DRF
* Exposure to working with SAP tools/skills such as Fiori Launchpad and Fiori Elements, SAPUI5, Javascript, GIT, WebIDE/BAS and other SAP technologies
* Experience with integrations using SOAP via SOA Manager, ODATA, IDOCs and Proxys
* Jira/Focused-build experience

At Lockheed Martin Rotary and Mission Systems (RMS), we tackle some of the most complex challenges in defense through innovation, collaboration, and engineering excellence. Lockheed Martin is seeking a Software Engineer to support our Advanced Launchers and Mk 41 Vertical Launching System (VLS) programs in Moorestown, NJ. You’ll join a collaborative Software Engineering team developing and supporting real-time embedded software for mission-critical systems.

* Apply software configuration management practices and ensure engineering standards are met.
* Independently determine technical approaches and develop solutions to challenging software problems.
* Work closely with cross-functional engineering teams to deliver reliable, high-quality capabilities.

Our RMS organization in Moorestown, NJ brings together talented engineers, scientists, and technical professionals who are passionate about advancing defense technology. You’ll collaborate with experienced teams working on sophisticated systems that make a real-world impact.

* Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC)
* Object-oriented programming
* Real-time embedded software development
* Software integration and test
* Software configuration management
* Software design, development, debugging, and documentation

**Standard Job Description**
WHAT WE'RE DOING
  
  
Lockheed Martin Rotary and Mission Systems is looking for Software professionals to work on Cross-Domain Solution (CDS) products that protect and defend the information flow of critical and time sensitive data on many military application and networks.
  
  
**Who We Are**
At Lockheed Martin Rotary and Mission Systems (RMS), you will ensure cyber security standards are met and implemented.
  
  
**Who You Are**
The candidate will be working in an agile development environment on Red Hat Enterprise Linux and will be responsible for supporting elements of the design/sustainment/development efforts. The candidate should be a well-rounded software developer with experience in an object-oriented language, such as C++ or Java. The candidate should be a self-starter that is attentive to details and works well in a team.
  
  
THE WORK
  
  
Duties to include software design and development in a variety of programming languages, including Java, C++, and Python, SELinux policy creation, maintenance and debugging, message parser development, XML schema development, networking, shell script development, and software test. The work environment offers a substantial amount of technical variety.
  
  
Additionally, the proven ability to provide software engineering is required. Flexibility and agility to changing requirements and programming languages, and a desire to learn and experience new opportunities to improve team performance is a must. Applicants selected will be subject to a government security investigation and must meet eligibility requirements for access to classified information. This team utilizes Agile methodologies, with 4 3-month increments per year. Each increment has 4 3-week sprints. A typical sprint will include planning, retrospectives, demos to stakeholders, development and test stories, and finally selloffs to track progress to a product owner. The development team works within the Deer Creek facility and at times can work remotely.
  
  
Additionally, as a developer for Radiant Mercury, you will have the opportunity to volunteer to support the end customers by travelling to site and performing installations or training of the product.
  
  
The individual selected for this team will need to be comfortable working independently and in a team environment. An ideal candidate will be a self-starter and a strong problem solver.
  
  
Many digital transformation techniques are used within the development environment including Jenkins, Git, Atlassian Suite of Tools, automated testing through software integration tests (SWIT), GoogleTest, and JUnit.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* Working knowledge of C++ or Java
* Familiarity with the Linux operating system
* Solid communication skills
* DoD Interim Secret Security Clearance

**Desired Skills**

* Some knowledge of network programming (TCP, UDP, IPC)
* Unit Testing – GoogleTest and JUnit
* Python, Perl, Bash
* Security Enhanced (SE) Linux
* Security+ certification
* Cross Domain Solutions and “Raise the Bar” requirements
* CI/CD - Jenkins, Fortify, Gerrit
* Git

WHAT WE'RE DOING
  
  
Lockheed Martin Rotary and Mission Systems is looking for Software professionals to work on Cross-Domain Solution (CDS) products that protect and defend the information flow of critical and time sensitive data on many military application and networks.
  
  
**Who We Are**
At Lockheed Martin Rotary and Mission Systems (RMS), you will ensure cyber security standards are met and implemented.
  
  
**Who You Are**
The candidate will be working in an agile development environment on Red Hat Enterprise Linux and will be responsible for supporting elements of the design/sustainment/development efforts. The candidate should be a well-rounded software developer with experience in an object-oriented language, such as C++ or Java. The candidate should be a self-starter that is attentive to details and works well in a team.
  
  
THE WORK
  
  
Duties to include software design and development in a variety of programming languages, including Java, C++, and Python, SELinux policy creation, maintenance and debugging, message parser development, XML schema development, networking, shell script development, and software test. This team utilizes Agile methodologies, with 4 3-month increments per year. Each increment has 4 3-week sprints. The development team works within the Deer Creek facility and at times can work remotely.
  
  
Additionally, as a developer for Radiant Mercury, you will have the opportunity to volunteer to support the end customers by travelling to site and performing installations or training of the product.
  
  
The individual selected for this team will need to be comfortable working independently and in a team environment. An ideal candidate will be a self-starter and a strong problem solver.

**Standard Job Description**
WHAT WE'RE DOING
  
  
Lockheed Martin Rotary and Mission Systems is looking for Software professionals to work on Cross-Domain Solution (CDS) products that protect and defend the information flow of critical and time sensitive data on many military application and networks.
  
  
**Who We Are**
At Lockheed Martin Rotary and Mission Systems (RMS), you will ensure cyber security standards are met and implemented.
  
  
**Who You Are**
The candidate will be working in an agile development environment on RedHat Linux-based OS, and will be responsible for supporting elements of the design/sustainment/development efforts. The candidate should be a well-rounded software developer with experience in an object oriented language, such as C++, C# and Java. The candidate should be a self-starter that is attentive to details and works well in a team.
  
  
THE WORK
  
  
Duties to include software design and development in a Java/C++/C# SELinux environment, SELinux Policy creation, maintenance and debugging, message parser development, XML schema development, network protocol integration, shell scripting development, and software test.
  
  
Additionally, the proven ability to provide software engineering is required. Flexibility and agility to changing requirements and programming languages, and a desire to learn and experience new opportunities to improve team performance is a must.
  
  
Applicants selected will be subject to a government security investigation and must meet eligibility requirements for access to classified information.
  
  
Join the team to help become “Raise the Bar” compliant. This compliance will involve the implementation of new stream and file pipelines for many different protocols including video.
  
  
This team promotes the Agile Methodologies, where it has 4 3-month increments per year. Each increment has 4 3-week sprints. A typical sprint will include planning, retrospectives, demos to stakeholders, development and test stories, and finally selloffs to track progress to a product owner. Each team will consist of a Scrum Master and 4-7 developers and testers. The development teams works within the Deer Creek facility and at times can work remote.
  
  
In addition as a developer for TMAN if you will have opportunities to volunteer support to the end customers by travelling to site and performing installations or trainings of the cross domain solution.
  
  
The individual selected for this team will need to have a high level of self and team motivation. An ideal candidate will be a self-starter and a strong problem solver. They will also need to have a deep understanding of continuous integration and deployment (CI/CD).
  
  
Many digital transformation techniques are used to facilitate development on the problem include Jenkins, Atlassian Suite of Tools, automated testing through software integration tests (SWIT), CPPUnit, JUnits with JMockit, and Eggplant.
  
  
This position will involve software development using Java / C++/C# and some bsh/python 80% of the time with a team that collaborates between each other hourly. SELInux policies are also important to TMAN as we are required to run our software with SELinux enabled. The Cross domain solution also requires strong linux and networking knowledge.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* DoD Interim Secret Security Clearance
* Working knowledge of C++, C# or Java
* Some knowledge of network programming, TCP, UDP, IPC
* Object-Oriented development
* Unit Testing – GTest, Junit, Jmockit

**Desired Skills**

* Python, Perl, Bash
* Linux
* SELinux
* Security+
* Cross Domain Solutions
* Raise the Bar
* CI/CD - Jenkins, Fortify, Sonarqube
* Version Control: Git/Bitbucket
